name: The Grand Vesper Hotel
description: Neoclassical luxury hotel situated north of the central rail terminus.

name: Vesper Central Station
description: Subterranean rail hub connecting municipal lines to northern freight corridors.

name: The Vesper Chronicle Newsroom
description: Editorial offices, library archives, and news telegraph desks.

name: North Gate Print Shop
description: Industrial printing press facility with mechanical composing bays and ink tanks.

name: Helios Fine Arts Gallery
description: Stately municipal exhibition hall featuring glass vitrines and antiquities.

name: North Freight Dock
description: Enclosed cargo staging bay equipped with security turnstiles and rolling shutters.

name: Blackwood Historical Archives
description: Limestone repository holding rare city deeds, municipal records, and codices.

name: Pier 9 Harbor Warehouse
description: Waterfront customs storage depot stacked with timber pallets and freight crates.

name: St. Jude District Infirmary
description: Victorian brick charity hospital with triage wards and an apothecary store.

name: District 4 Constabulary
description: Municipal police headquarters with booking desks, cells, and evidence storage.

name: Vulcan Steam Foundry
description: Heavy industrial smelting works with blast furnaces and iron casting floor.

name: The Meridian Clocktower
description: Civic telegraph exchange and municipal timepiece dominating Central Square.

name: Old Riverfront Market
description: Covered cobblestone market pavilion alongside the canal docks.

name: Glass Botanical Conservatory
description: Ornate cast-iron and glass conservatory housing exotic flora and research hotbeds.

name: Solaris Hill Observatory
description: High-altitude astronomical dome overlooking the foggy sprawl of Vesper City.

name: Highgate Cablecar Station
description: Funicular rail terminus transporting passengers up the steep hills to Highgate.
